source.chemistry: EDI knb-lter-ntl.1 (NTL-LTER chemistry), June-August 2019, samples at <= 2 m; Mendota N and P from the WSLH columns (mg/L converted to ug/L)
source.troutlake: EDI knb-lter-ntl.117 (Trout Lake hourly buoy), July 2019; glitch oxygen values (<0 or >20 mg/L) removed
source.troutbog: EDI knb-lter-ntl.69 (Trout Bog high-resolution DO, averaged to the hour); PAR modelled from the 25 cm HOBO lux logger at 0.0185 umol/m2/s per lux
source.metabolism: GPP/ER/NEP: bookkeeping method (as Module 6), July 2019; Trout Bog wind = 2003-2014 July mean and z_mix = 1 m (assumed); Mendota and Trout Lake z_mix from thermistor chains (ntl130, ntl116)
